notes: Validated for text chat (non-streaming and streaming), sampling (top_p/seed/stop applied; seeded determinism observed), json_schema structured output forwarded natively and validated after generation, hidden reasoning, cancellation, two concurrent streams, error mapping, lifecycle lease semantics, engine stop/restart, and mid-stream engine loss.
Tool calling is inconclusive on this 0.5B model (it emitted a malformed <tool_call> block); vision, embeddings, and rerank were not probed. None of these are claimed.
Middleware overhead on repeated-prefix requests: +4.8 ms p50 / +4.9 ms p95 time-to-first-content at concurrency 1, within the roadmap target; no measurable overhead at concurrency 2.
